take: Chicago announced it placed defenseman Bowen Byram on injured reserve and recalled forward Dillon Boucher from the minors. Byram was the top-pair defenseman at 24:42 a night and on the first power-play unit, and in the 5 games since he went out, Wyatt Kaiser has moved in beside Levshunov and is up to 20:07 a night from 18:06, Teuvo Teravainen has taken his place on the first power-play unit, and Ian Cole is up to 20:28 from 16:20. The Blackhawks are 4-10-1, and in Byram's six games they took 38% of the expected goals (a measure of chance quality) with him on the ice at five-on-five.
